name: NCT
recent: 主要集资发展两个工业园项目；同时以RM53百万认购Semanja Murni 80%股权，并延长以RM22百万收购NCT Marina Bay 51%股权的条件期限。最新季度净利按年增长96%至RM15.9百万，但9个月营收下滑24%，未派息。
notable: 936,639股新股（占已发行股本最多10%），集资发展NCT Smart Industrial Park和NCT InnoSphere。
以RM53百万认购Semanja Murni 80%扩大后股权，并签署补充协议修改条款。
延长以RM22百万收购NCT Marina Bay 51%股权的条件期限至2026年12月19日。
risks: 私下配售最多10%新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
董事在闭市期前表示有意交易公司股票。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收RM87.05百万，按季跌10.6%，按年跌56.9%；净利RM20.50百万，按季升32.8%，按年跌16.7%；净利率23.6%，高于上季的15.9%。

recent_en: NCT Alliance proposes a private placement of up to 10% new shares mainly to fund two industrial park projects; it is also subscribing for 80% of Semanja Murni for RM53 million and has extended the conditional period for the RM22 million acquisition of 51% of NCT Marina Bay. Latest quarterly net profit rose 96% year-on-year to RM15.9 million, but 9-month revenue fell 24%, with no dividend declared.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 304,936,639 new shares (up to 10% of issued shares) to fund NCT Smart Industrial Park and NCT InnoSphere.
Subscription of 80% enlarged equity interest in Semanja Murni for RM53 million, with a supplemental agreement varying terms.
Extension of the conditional period for the RM22 million acquisition of 51% of NCT Marina Bay to 19 December 2026.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Directors indicated intention to deal in the company's shares during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM87.05 million, down 10.6% QoQ and 56.9% YoY; net profit was RM20.50 million, up 32.8% QoQ but down 16.7% YoY; net margin was 23.6%, higher than 15.9% in the previous quarter.
